blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
It was my first month at Czarnikow. I started my new job in April. The first day was exciting and a little scary.

I worked with the HR team every day. I learned many new things, and I met all my colleagues. Sophie helped me a lot, and Tom trained me. We had weekly meetings, and I always arrived on time.

I enjoyed every day. It was a great first month, and now I feel like part of the team.

items.q: When did the person start the new job?
items.why: "I started my new job in April."

items.q: Who helped the person a lot?
items.why: "Sophie helped me a lot." O Tom treinou; a Sophie ajudou.

items.q: How did the person feel about the first month?
items.why: "I enjoyed every day. It was a great first month." — sentimento positivo.

items.q: The text suggests that the person is now…
items.why: Inferência: "now I feel like part of the team" — a pessoa se integrou.

items.q: The words "exciting and a little scary" suggest that the first day was…
options: a normal day like any other
items.why: Inferência: um primeiro dia "exciting and a little scary" é novo e um pouco tenso.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com você sobre o seu primeiro mês. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! It's Sophie. I want to say congratulations. You finished your first month at Czarnikow!

I remember your first day. You arrived early, and you were a little nervous. That is normal. Everybody is nervous on the first day. But you smiled, and you said hello to everyone.

You worked hard every week. You learned fast, and you asked good questions. Tom trained you, and he told me you did a great job. In our meetings, you listened and you helped the team. I was very happy.

Next month we start a new project together. I think you are ready. You can do it! Let's have a coffee tomorrow and talk about it. See you soon!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why does Sophie call?
items.why: "I want to say congratulations. You finished your first month."

items.q: How was the person on the first day?
items.why: "You arrived early, and you were a little nervous."

items.q: What did Tom tell Sophie?
options: That the person did a great job
That the person wants to leave
That the person needs more training
items.why: "Tom trained you, and he told me you did a great job."

items.q: Sophie's words suggest that she is…
items.why: Inferência: congratulações, elogios e "I was very happy" mostram orgulho.

items.q: When Sophie says "I think you are ready", she means…
options: the person can start the new project
the person needs to study more
items.why: Inferência: "Next month we start a new project… I think you are ready."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I started my job in April." Started means…
items.why: Started = comecei/começou (passado de start).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Last week I ___ with the HR team on a report."
items.why: Worked = trabalhei (passado de work).

items.q: "I learned many new things this month." Learned means…
items.why: Learned = aprendi (passado de learn).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "On my first day, I ___ all my new colleagues."
items.why: Met = conheci (passado de meet).

items.q: "I really enjoyed the team lunch." Enjoyed means…
items.why: Enjoyed = curti/gostei (passado de enjoy).

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Sophie always helps out the new people." To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = ajudar, dar uma mão.

items.q: "I arrived on time for every meeting." On time means…
items.why: On time = na hora certa, sem atraso.

items.q: "I look forward to the new project." To look forward to means to…
options: feel happy about something in the future
items.why: Look forward to = estar animado/esperar algo com vontade.

items.q: "I get on well with my colleagues." This means I…
options: have a good relationship with them
items.why: Get on well with = se dar bem com alguém.

items.q: "I took part in the weekly meeting." To take part in means to…
options: join and be active in it
items.why: Take part in = participar de algo.
